messages:
lee: quick check — planning a small StatefulSet tweak for redis-query to reduce pod churn during canary. will push a Terraform change + k8s manifest update. tagging infra folks for quick review.

ana: what exactly are you changing? replica counts / rollout? any HPA impact?

lee: plan is: keep replicas at 5 for now, add a RollingUpdate partition=1 so only 1 pod is updated (canary), bump readiness initialDelaySeconds to 20 to avoid flapping on start, set maxUnavailable: 0, maxSurge: 1. also add a preStop sleep to give connections time to drain. will update infra repo so staging canary runs first.

sam: HPA? we still have HPA on cpu, right — if minReplicas is < partition we might underprovision during canary.

lee: good point. HPA is managed in a separate TF resource. I plan to set minReplicas to 3 in the same PR to be safe.

jen: preStop sleep 10s might be too short for active streams. can we do 30s or add a graceful drain hook?

lee: yea makes sense. thinking 30s. also adding lifecycle preStop exec: sleep 30.

lee: here's the manifest snippet i'll push (will live in infra/apps/redis-query/k8s.yaml):

```
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: StatefulSet
metadata:
  name: redis-query
spec:
  replicas: 5
  updateStrategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
    rollingUpdate:
      partition: 1
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: redis-query
        readinessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /health
            port: 8080
          initialDelaySeconds: 20
          periodSeconds: 10
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: "200m"
            memory: "256Mi"
          limits:
            cpu: "500m"
            memory: "512Mi"
        lifecycle:
          preStop:
            exec:
              command: ["/bin/sh","-c","sleep 30"]
```

lee: Terraform change will update the k8s_manifest and the aws_autoscaling settings (minReplicas -> 3). will run plan in staging first.

devops-bot: CI: terraform plan for infra/redis-query — no destructive changes. plan shows cfg changes to k8s_manifest and hpa.minReplicas = 3. (link: https://ci.internal/redwood/plan/7829) :white_check_mark:

ana: small nit — if we set partition=1 on a 5-replica sts that's a 20% canary, ok. just make sure console alerting is muted for that window, otherwise ops will get paged.

sam: i'll run a quick load test in staging after apply to confirm CPU scaling stable.

jen: please include a note in PR about secret wiring — we aren't changing secret names, right?

lee: no secret renames. configmap unchanged. only manifest + HPA minReplicas.

lee: opened PR infra/redis-query#4213 — include manifest + terraform tweak + apply script. tagging @ana @sam @jen for review. target apply: Wed 10:30 PT.

ana: looking now, will review by EOD.

sam: quick +1 after my local run.

jen: +1 on preStop 30s and readiness bump. will check logs for in-flight connections after staging apply.

devops-bot: Deploy note: scheduled staging apply for 2026-03-18T18:30:00Z — automated plan + apply will run.

lee: thanks all — will wait for thumbs, then kick off staging. :thumbsup:
